name: dsh-tool-stat
description: Zero-dependency descriptive statistics host tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe / percentile / frequency / correlation over finite numeric arrays, using Neumaier compensated summation, Welford variance, NumPy-linear percentiles and midrank Spearman.

plugin.note: Host-plane zero-dependency statistics tool: one 'stat' tool covering describe/percentile/frequency/correlation with strict finite-number hygiene and never-NaN output.
